text: If your reflection ever tells you to run... do not look back.
Do not wipe the mirror. Do not ask it why. Do not turn around.
This is Protocol four zero four.
There are four rules. Follow them exactly. Otherwise, you will have to activate the emergency protocol.
Rule one. Do not test your reflection.
It starts late at night. You are washing your hands at the bathroom sink.
You look up. Your reflection looks up... a moment later.
Less than a second. You tell yourself you are tired.
Do not wave at it. Do not tilt your head to see if it follows.
Every time you test it, it falls further behind. One second. Two. Three.
Your reflection is not slow. Something is holding it back.
If you test it, this is what would happen.
Rule two. Do not look behind your reflection.
Behind you, the bathroom door is closed.
In the mirror, it is open.
Something is standing in the doorway. Tall. Too thin. Its head touches the frame.
It is only in the mirror. If you turn around, there will be nothing there.
That is why you must not turn around. The moment your eyes leave the mirror, your reflection is alone with it.
Your reflection is standing between you and that door. That is why it is late.
Rule three. When it writes, run.
The mirror will fog up. The water is cold.
A line will appear in the fog. Drawn from the other side of the glass.
Your reflection is writing backwards, so that you can read it.
R. U. N.
Behind your reflection, the doorway is empty now.
Run. Do not look back at the mirror.
Rule four. Emergency protocol. How to fight back.
If you were too slow, a hand will come through the glass. Long grey fingers, around your wrist.
Here is what does not work.
Do not pull. It is stronger than you.
Do not break the mirror. Every piece becomes a new window.
Do not call for help. Whoever comes will look into the mirror too.
There is only one thing that works.
Put your free hand flat on the glass.
Your reflection will press its hand against yours. Palm to palm.
Then it will turn around, and pull the grey hand off you.
You will be free. Do not stay to watch.
Cover the mirror with a towel. Whatever you hear behind it tonight, do not lift it.
In the morning, take the towel down. Your reflection will be there. Exactly on time.
It will look up when you look up. It will wash its hands when you wash yours.
When you leave, you will turn your back to the mirror. So will it.
You will never see its back.
And that was Protocol four zero four.
If this ever happens to you... you know the protocol.
